First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

builds.name: Spirit Cleave: five-champion AD shield
builds.summary: Investigate high one Spirit Cleave shield after five champion hits output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Spirit Cleave shield after five champion hits output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The base shield helper scales from 40 to 90 by level plus 0.65 bonus AD and lasts 1.5 seconds. Raw data also contains first-champion and additional-champion shield multipliers of 1 and 0.5. Their combination with the base layer must be measured; five targets do not mean five unmodified full shields. W physical/magic damage is separate.

ceiling.targetName: one Spirit Cleave shield after five champion hits
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 30%, target HP 100%, observation 1.5s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop observed damage at death, cap observed healing at missing HP, and report raw output separately. Exactly five living enemy champions inside one actual W cone, one cast and no prior shield. Owner 30%, exactly 500 earned Heartsteel HP, exactly 10 earned Hubris kills and temporary buff active. Record actual Bloodmail AD, bonus AD and shield capacity immediately after all five hits. Separate Sterak and any other shield.
